intent: Simplify argument comparison in OverlappingFieldsCanBeMergedRule by replacing sameArguments/stringifyValue with a single stringifyArguments that wraps a field's arguments in a synthetic object value, sorts it via sortValueNode, and prints it. Intended as behavior-preserving.
residual_risks: Duplicate argument names: old sameArguments matched each argument to the first same-named one in the other list (order-dependent); new string comparison is stricter and symmetric, so f(a:1,a:1) vs f(a:1,a:2) now reports 'differing arguments'. Only reachable for documents UniqueArgumentNamesRule already rejects; reported by the adversarial read at P3 advisory, not retained as a finding (no change needed). Reproduced by the reviewer on the new code only.
Performance: both argument lists are now always printed per compared pair (old code short-circuited on count mismatch and skipped printing for zero-arg fields). Constant-factor only; not benchmarked.
naturalCompare tie behavior on argument names was brute-forced over small alphabets (~4.7k names) with no ties found; longer names not searched.
testing_gaps: No test pins duplicate-argument-name behavior or argument names that naturalCompare treats specially (e.g. a01/a1) in swapped order; the 46 existing tests in OverlappingFieldsCanBeMergedRule-test.ts pass.

coverage.notes: Focused path: correctness read in-context plus one independent local adversarial-reviewer (same Sonnet 5.5 family; the cross-model peer was unavailable by configuration, so it is corroboration only, not cross-model). No other reviewers or validator ran. No criteria files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/CODING_STANDARDS.md) in the tree; no plan found. Not assessed: learnings, agent-native gaps, deployment notes, Compound Packs. Verification: OverlappingFieldsCanBeMergedRule-test.ts 46 passing; eslint clean on changed file.
